scholarship_title: Boustany Foundation Cambridge University MBA Scholarship 2027
provider_organization: Boustany Foundation (Monaco), with the University of Cambridge (Pembroke College)
eligible_nationalities: All (priority to candidates of Lebanese descent)

additional_benefits: Travel, food and accommodation for the required two-month internship in Monaco

application_fee.notes: No fee mentioned on the Foundation's page.

required_documents.name: Cambridge MBA acceptance letter
required_documents.detail: You can only apply after receiving an offer

preparation_alerts: Get a Cambridge MBA offer first; you can only apply for the scholarship after that
Winners must do a two-month unpaid internship at the Foundation's Monaco office
Scholars are placed at Pembroke College

selection_criteria.pass_rule: One scholarship every two years; phone interview possible

verification_status.verification_notes: Award is made every two years; this round is for the Cambridge MBA class starting autumn 2027, deadline 31 May 2027, results June 2027. No opening date is given, so status is unknown (you can apply once you have an MBA offer). 'Bi-annual' here means every two years. Only one award per round and priority to Lebanese descent, so chances for Nigerian applicants are low. The Foundation also has an Astronomy PhD award at Cambridge, not covered here.
